description: Free start times for one service, in the business's local time zone, for the next days. Use the service id from get_services. Optionally pick a professional and a start date. Times change as people book; the booking link shows the current times.

business.description: The business identifier returned by search_businesses (the part after /agendar/ in its booking link).

date.description: First day to check, YYYY-MM-DD in the business's local date. Default: today.

days.description: How many days to check (1 to 14). Default 7.

professional_id.description: Professional id from get_services. Leave out for any professional.

name: get_available_slots
title: Check free appointment times
